policy.rule: NORMAL RELEASE = DELTA SYNC. FULL VERIFY = EXCEPTION ONLY.
policy.unchangedMeans: If a canonical file's sha256 equals its last successfully synced sha256, it is UNCHANGED and must receive ZERO Google Drive connector calls: no search, no read-back, no download, no create, no archive, no byte diff. UNCHANGED = SKIP is a hard rule, not a preference.
policy.emptyDelta: If no canonical file changed, finalize:release prints MEETING_ROOM_CLOUD_SYNC = NOT_REQUIRED and the Google Drive Connector must not be opened at all.
policy.fullVerifyReporting: Any run that uses full verify MUST state FULL_VERIFY_REASON = <one of the exceptions above> in its final report. An agent may never start a full verify for its own reassurance.
policy.autoEscalation: manifest-evidence-untrustworthy is the ONLY exception that may be raised automatically (by scripts/meeting-room-delta.mjs) -- without a usable baseline a diff is meaningless, so escalating is the honest option.

note: update_file on this Connector only supports title/parentId, never content -- an existing canonical file is NEVER updated in place. See scripts/finalize-release.mjs and PROJECT_HANDOFF.md for the full protocol writeup. Folder IDs are not secrets and may be committed; no Google credential of any kind is ever stored here.

fallback.note: Kept, never removed. Used only when the Google Drive Connector is unavailable to the executing Claude session.

lastSync.statusNote: The delta planner requires exactly "success" (scripts/meeting-room-delta.mjs, assessManifestEvidence). A previous run recorded "PASS" here, which the planner correctly treated as untrustworthy evidence and escalated to a full verify. The sync itself had genuinely succeeded and was byte-verified; only the label was wrong. Keep this value as "success" — never widen the planner to accept other spellings, because that guard is what stops an unverified manifest from being trusted.
lastSync.detail: Accident-only LINE push policy + CCTV restore. 6 canonical files changed and were created and verified; 4 unchanged (01/04/05/06) received ZERO connector calls. Read-back byte diff PASS on SYSTEM_STATE.json. Superseded copies moved to _archive_21c1a42, never trashed. Canonical folder verified 10/10 present, 0 missing, 0 duplicate.
lastSync.processNote: This round needed several upload rounds because the export was regenerated after files had already been uploaded, so generatedAt moved and the uploaded copies went stale. Freeze the export (run it last, commit, confirm a clean tree) BEFORE uploading anything; otherwise every regeneration invalidates work already synced and fills the archive folder with near-identical drafts. One 07_KNOWN_ISSUES.md upload was also hand-transcribed and lost a clause — upload the file as generated, never a retyped copy.
